name: 8hats-qa
description: QA SCRATCH — not the real marketplace. A throwaway copy of 8hats/marketplace carrying PRs #1+#2+#3+#4 together, so Claude Desktop can be tested against them before they merge. Desktop's 'add marketplace' takes owner/repo with no ref, so a branch cannot be tested any other way. The name is 8hats-qa, not 8hats, so adding this cannot retarget the real registration. Delete after use.
